title: Welcome Beaches | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Welcome Beaches,' just steps from the sugar-white sands. This beautifully reimagined studio is designed for effortless beach vacations, offering style, comfort, and the perfect location for making memories. A cozy king bed nook, sleek appliances, and custom cabinetry make the studio feel both luxurious and practical, while high-end finishes give it a fresh, modern vibe. Start your mornings with coffee on your private balcony overlooking the courtyard and sparkling community pool, then grab your beach bag, it’s only 100 feet to the Gulf with dedicated beach access directly across the street. After a sun-soaked day, cool off with a swim, or hop on one of the 2 adult bikes included with your stay to explore the 30A bike path, Seaside, and nearby coastal towns. Whether you’re here for a romantic getaway, a solo escape, or a little beach reset, this retreat puts you in the heart of it all. With Seaside Town Center just a short ride away, you’ll have boutique shops, great restaurants, and that signature laid-back 30A charm right at your fingertips. Perfectly located, stylishly designed, and only steps from the sand. This Seagrove Beach studio is ready to be your home away from home on 30A. **The studio is located on the building’s second floor. STUDIO CONDO FEATURES -Community pool -Gas grills by pool area -100 feet from the beach access -2 Adult bikes -Smart tv -Fully stocked kitchen -Keurig/drip coffee makers -Beach gear -Short distance to access restaurants, market, shops, and entertainment -Complimentary wifi -Credit card operated washer and dryer machines ACCOMMODATIONS: Welcome Beaches accommodates up to 2 people: Bed 1: King **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Parking access available in front of building. We provide 2 bikes for your convenience! NEARBY BEACH ACCESS 1. Pelayo Beach Access (100 ft from the home) is on Scenic 30A at the intersection of Pelayo Avenue across from Hidden Beach Villas. There is a shower and a bike rack but no car parking. A long boardwalk through a grove of coastal trees leads to a large deck with seating on high bluff overlooking the gulf. 2. Santa Clara beach (0.2 Miles from the home) access is located near Bramble Grove Road. This beach has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. For your convenience beach chairs, umbrellas, and kayaks are available to rent from beach services. 3. Campbell St. Beach Access (800 ft. from the home) is on Scenic 30A across from Campbell Street and the Seagrove Plaza. 4. Seagrove Regional Beach Access is located on Scenic 30A across from Cafe Thirty-A, Seagrove Regional Beach Access offers parking (including ADA and bike spaces), restrooms, an ADA-accessible dune walkover with showers, and access to the multi-use path. It also features stormwater management, seasonal lifeguards (10 a.m.–6 p.m.), and a beach wheelchair for accessibility. ABOUT THE AREA Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community that is on 30a, nestled between Seaside and Watersound. Seagrove is perfect for nature lovers seeking an unspoiled retreat and uncrowded environment. Enjoy canoeing, kayaking, swimming and more in this quaint town with Old Florida charm. You will find restaurants and shops within walking distance, and a quick bike ride will land you in Seaside, a well-known 30A spot with farmers markets, shops, restaurants, and local food trucks to fill your entire parties needs. Take a quick bike ride east in the opposite direction, and you can find yourself at the Big Chill, a popular outdoor space filled with restaurants, outdoor games, and big screen TVs to watch any sporting event your heart desires. 30A is located in between the beach and a 15,000-acre forest that is filled with hiking trails and off-road trails, for those that want to skip the beach and want a different experience. Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 30 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a little over a 1 hour drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited. *No parties or events. *Complimentary bikes (2) provided. Waiver must be completed for bike lock code. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *This unit must remain pet free. *There are no refunds for weather related events. We advise trip insurance during hurricane season (May-November) IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Other things to note
